player_prompt.intro:
Droeureuh Player {player_id} lam JoJoJoin, meu'en pada papan 5x5 ngon sél nan di nomor 0-24.
Bak watee giliran, tamah tanda droeureuh bak sél nan kosong, misa '[12]'.
KA MEUNANG uléh meurumpok peuet tanda droeureuh bak saboh baréh — peuet sél nan turut-turut horizontal, vertikal, atawa diagonal.
Seubagoe Player {player_id} droeureuh '{symbol}'; lawan droeureuh '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Langkah nyang ka ji peuturi hana meurupa format.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} kon sel nyang sah. Harusnya antara 0 dan 24.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} tamah tanda droeureuh ({symbol}) bak sél {cell}.
